items.raw_excerpt: Ohakune residents will have to boil their tap water when it returns.
items.summary_en: Ohakune residents will have to boil their tap water once the supply returns. The precautionary notice comes after good progress was made restoring the water service.

items.raw_excerpt: City of Copenhagen terminate agreement with delivery service, Dao, highest number of weddings registered for June in at least 20 years, and more news from Denmark on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: The city of Copenhagen will stop working with the delivery service Dao. More weddings were registered for June than in any year in the last 20 years. Here is a roundup of Tuesday's news from Denmark.

items.raw_excerpt: Business owners believe people are spending fewer evenings and less cash in Skegness this summer.
items.summary_en: Shop owners in Skegness say people spend fewer evenings in the town this summer. Visitors are going home earlier and spending less money.

items.raw_excerpt: How is your school doing on teaching pupils life-saving swimming skills in the English curriculum?
items.summary_en: Many English schools do not teach children enough swimming skills. A new online tool lets you search for your school and see how it is doing. The gap between pupils' swimming ability across England is now clear.

items.raw_excerpt: Amanda Cole previously hid her condition but now wants others to "tic freely" without embarrassment.
items.summary_en: Amanda Cole has Tourette's syndrome. She used to hide her tics, but now she teaches at Cambridge. She hopes others can tic freely without embarrassment.

items.raw_excerpt: “Opportunistic” plans to build 100 homes on green belt land outside a Yorkshire village could be approved later this week.
items.summary_en: A plan would build 100 homes on green belt land near a Yorkshire village. Local people fear the development would make two villages merge together. The decision could come later this week.
